correctness.rationale: Write x=kn, A=π(x) and d=π(x+n)−A. All primes in the increment interval are odd, so kd≤k ceil(n/2)≤3x/5 for n≥5. For x≥17 the Rosser–Schoenfeld lower bound and monotonicity of u log u give A log A>x(1−log log x/log x)>3x/5. The strict logarithm estimate follows from 17^(2/5)>3>log 17 and positivity of (x^(2/5)−log x)' thereafter. Thus k log(1+d/A)≤kd/A<log A, including d=0, which gives exactly the stated strict power inequality. Independently enumerated the kn<17 cases by trial-division primality and integer powers; all 17 pairs and both columns of powers agree with RESULT.md, lines 144–166. The finite rectangle in the supplied checker is supportive only; it was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The exact location of the classical bound in the original Rosser–Schoenfeld full text was not independently inspected; direct lawful retrieval did not expose the theorem passage.
